# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub: **Security → Report a vulnerability** on
[jaxcksn/twip](https://github.com/jaxcksn/twip/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue.

Include the version, the SDK (Rust, .NET or web), and a document or steps that reproduce the problem. Twip parses
untrusted DOCX files, so crashes, hangs and unbounded memory use on a crafted file count as security issues.

You'll get a reply within a week. Fixes ship as a patch release for the latest minor version.

## Supported versions

Before 1.0, only the latest release gets fixes.
